## Names

<a id="music_instruments"></a>
### [`music_instruments`](../../../../src/music/music_data.asm#L8) `$E80A-$E849`

*data*

8 instruments of 8 bytes: AD, SR for articulation 0 (normal), AD, SR for articulation 1 (staccato), AD, SR for articulation 2 (legato), 2 unused bytes. Command $Bn selects instrument n. The title tune uses instruments 0, 3 and 5.

- **Read by:** [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E731`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L579), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E740`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L587), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E74F`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L595), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E782`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L625), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E789`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L628), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E790`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L631), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E795`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L634)

<a id="music_filter_presets"></a>
### [`music_filter_presets`](../../../../src/music/music_data.asm#L19) `$E84A-$E869`

*data*

8 filter presets of 4 bytes: cutoff low ($D415), cutoff high ($D416), resonance in the high nibble ($D417), filter mode ($10 low pass, $20 band pass, $40 high pass) for $D418. Command $Dn.

- **Read by:** [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E782`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L625), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E789`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L628), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E790`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L631), [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length) [`$E795`](../../../../src/music/music_player_e38c.asm#L634)
